name: Kirishima Shun
source:
Star Sign: Gemini
Nationality: Japanese
Job: University Student
Special Skill: Planning Strategies, Ciphers

The mediator for the team.
He came to New York to study language. He's very sociable.
He has exceptional memory and judgement.
His parents died in an accident when he was a child, so he was raised by his grandmother.
